opening.argument: The video presents an on-location interview focused on the farmers' movement and political activity in Uttar Pradesh: the reporter identifies Rakesh Tikait and asks whether the movement has become weak, then asks what he will do in the Uttar Pradesh elections. The visible NDTV-branded microphone and interview setting reinforce that this is presented as news-style public commentary, while the title also frames the discussion around Tikait and the UP elections. Its subject is political discussion, including voting advice and criticism of parties, not a request for money, credentials, private data, or participation in an investment arrangement.

citations.quote: Rakesh Tikait is with us. He is not required to introduce himself. Rakesh ji, has the farmer's movement become weak?
Rakesh ji, what will you do in the Uttar Pradesh elections?
What will Rakesh Tikait do in UP elections? Telling Saurabh Shukla
